failed_jobs.name: Tests / Run VS Code extension unit tests (Windows) / Run VS Code extension unit tests (Windows)
failed_jobs.reason: Job fails with generic 'Process completed with exit code 1' and no retrievable job logs. Matches known recurring flaky pattern for this job (issue #19270) that has occurred previously unrelated to PR content. The PR only touches interactionService.ts, ExtensionBackchannel.cs, and ExtensionInteractionService.cs, not the extension unit test harness itself.

failed_jobs.reason: Failed at the 'Install Azure Functions Core Tools' step with exit code 22, matching a known recurring infra issue where the Azure Functions Core Tools npm install fails with HTTP 404 from cdn.functions.azure.com (issue #19166). This is unrelated to the PR, which only changes VS Code extension interaction service and CLI backchannel code.

failed_jobs.name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Windows, dynamic-debug-configuration)
failed_jobs.reason: Test teardown fails with 'EBUSY: resource busy or locked, rmdir ...\.e2e-dynamic-debug\first' on Windows, a well-known recurring flaky teardown race condition for this shard (issue #19576, 21 prior occurrences). Unrelated to the PR's changes to interaction service/backchannel code.
